name: SmartEdge Diagnostics Agent
description: AIOps diagnostic agent for the Enterprise's SmartEdge Gateway product. Analyzes devices stuck on LTE (5G SIM) instead of switching back to fiber. Determines root cause and recommends least-disruptive resolution to avoid truck rolls.

skills.name: Analyze Device LTE Duration
skills.description: Determines how long a specific SmartEdge Gateway device has been stuck on LTE instead of fiber, identifies root cause, and recommends action. Severity: GREEN (<60min), YELLOW (60-90min), RED (>90min).
examples: Why is device SE-GW-1234567890 stuck on LTE?
Check if customer's SmartEdge Gateway device needs a truck roll

skills.name: Bulk Device Analysis
skills.description: Analyzes multiple SmartEdge Gateway devices at once. Returns prioritized list of devices needing attention, sorted by severity and cost impact.

skills.name: Recommend Remediation
skills.description: Given a device ID and diagnosed root cause, generates step-by-step customer-facing troubleshooting instructions. Prioritizes self-service. Only recommends truck roll as last resort.
